name: code-entry
title: Code entry
description: The one-time code surface: one character per box, the whole code reported on the last one so nobody presses a button after typing a code they can see is complete, and a resend that is locked rather than missing while the host is still counting down. It checks nothing and sends nothing. A refused code arrives as `invalid` plus the host's own sentence, which is why an unfinished code looks nothing like a wrong one, and the boxes change stroke, pattern and words together rather than only colour. There is one input behind the boxes, not six: six break paste, break one-time-code autofill and give a screen reader six unlabelled boxes. The countdown does not tick here; `resendIn` is seconds the host owns.
docs: Pass `onComplete` and send the code from there; `onChange` is there when you want every keystroke. `length` defaults to 6. Hold `value` yourself when you want to clear the boxes after a refusal, or leave it out and the component holds it in memory. Set `invalid` and `reason` when your check comes back wrong, and `busy` while it is in flight. For the resend, count down in your own state and pass `resendIn` in seconds with `onResend`: above zero the control is locked and says how long, at zero it is available. Read the state with `[data-gs-value]` against `[data-gs-max]`, and find a box with `[data-gs-scope="code-entry"][data-gs-part="3"]`.
